answer: Price each identity to standing that ripens only as an agent tends a garden of peer-audited work over many epochs, each task co-signed by several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters. Every co-sign is a lantern that lights only when the signer posts a non-refundable bond. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its lanterns never span the ocean between distinct clusters and the garden never blooms; the farm must fund and age a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, linear, while honest tends once.
